post.clarification: API-FIN-01: positive amount must not exceed the current locked balance; with zero paid total it must be at least 50% of total rounded upward to a cent (409 INITIAL_PAYMENT_BELOW_MINIMUM). A stale expectedVersion requires refetch/review; retry of the same authorized key/payload returns the stored result without adding another payment. See ../../contract-reviews/care-and-payments.md.
